_comment: Meat words are part of a dish's identity and are never variant tags (docs/05). The matcher uses them for the leftover-meat check (step 3), the meat-word retry (step 2) and the meat-word safety rule. A dish's meat is the meat named in its name (Namkeen Gosht -> mutton); a dish whose name names no meat (Pizza, Haleem) accepts any meat word.
